# Dōbutsu no Mori e+ PC/Android port v1.4.0

Version 1.4.0 of the port that runs [afe-decomp](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-decomp) (the どうぶつの森 e+ decompilation) on PC and Android.

## Changes since v1.3.1

- **Tools in other players' hands.** In multiplayer you now see what the others hold, drawn the way the game draws
  it: the net, axe, fishing rod, shovel, umbrella (custom-design umbrellas as their owner drew them), balloon,
  pinwheel, fan, flower and party popper. The arms take the pose for holding the item, and the net and rod move as they
  swing or cast. An item held up after picking it up or digging it up shows too.
- **The same item taken by two players goes to the first.** Before, two players picking up the same item at the same
  moment both got it. Now the host gives it to the first, and the other player's pocket gives it back. A guest that
  could not put an item down gets it back.
- **More of the host's houses is shared**: lamps, TVs and radios on or off, the record in a stereo, what storage
  furniture holds and the gyroids' steps. While the host was inside a room, its storage furniture used to read as
  empty to guests.
- **More of the town follows the host**:
  - the houses' outside (size, roof colour, basement, the mailbox's flag);
  - the gyroid at a house's door: what a guest buys goes into the guest's pockets, and the bells and the gyroid's
    stock change on the host's side too;
  - the villagers' own data (their clothes and umbrellas, moving in or out);
  - the extra bridge, the lighthouse, the fishing tourney, Blanca, the town's assessment and the other town events.
- Signed with the same key as the previous version, so it installs over it (saves, the Korean patch and texture
  packs are kept).

## Updating

- **From v1.0.0 or later**, the game finds this version when it starts and offers to update (**Update now**; on
  Android, **업데이트** in the dialog).
- v0.1.6 and earlier cannot update themselves: install this version by hand once.
- **Everyone in a room needs this version.** The multiplayer's messages changed, so v1.3.x cannot join a v1.4.0 room.

## Read this first

- **No game data is included.** You need your own disc image of the Japanese 「どうぶつの森 e+」 **Rev 1 (GAEJ01)**
  (`.iso` / `.ciso` / `.gcm`) to run it. Disc images are not distributed.
- **To play in Korean**, download the Korean patch from [retrodb 한글패치 — 동물의 숲 e+](https://retrodb.info/krpatch/7428/%EB%8F%99%EB%AC%BC%EC%9D%98-%EC%88%B2-e)
  and apply it in the game (pause menu → Settings → Disc → Korean patch → Install...). The Korean patch is the work of an
  independent author (역전맞고) unrelated to this repository.
- Multiplayer: [README](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/blob/main/README.md#multiplayer).

## Files

| File | For |
|---|---|
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.4.0-Windows-x64.zip` | 64-bit Windows. Includes `SDL2.dll`, requires OpenGL 3.3 |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.4.0-Windows-x86.zip` | 32-bit Windows (also runs on 64-bit Windows). Includes `SDL2.dll`, requires OpenGL 3.3 |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.4.0-Linux-x86_64.zip` | 64-bit Linux. Requires SDL2 (`libsdl2-2.0-0`) and an OpenGL 3.3 driver |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.4.0-Android.apk` | Android 5.0 or later, 32/64-bit ARM (armeabi-v7a, arm64-v8a) |
| `SHA256SUMS.txt` | SHA-256 of the files above |

## Verified

Two copies of the game (Linux) with two saved towns, the guest in the host's town:

- Tools: the host takes out a net, umbrella, balloon and axe in turn. Each shows in the host's hand on the guest's
  screen, and the host's net swing plays there too.
- Picking up: the host picks up an apple. On the guest's screen the host bends down and lifts the apple, and the
  apple is gone from the ground.
- The door gyroid: the host's gyroid sells an apple and cherries, and the guest talks to it and buys the apple.
  - On the guest: 100 bells are taken and the apple is in the pockets.
  - On the host: the gyroid holds 100 bells, the apple is gone and the cherries are still for sale.
- Houses:
  - The host walking into its house no longer rebuilds the guest's room.
  - Furniture the host puts down shows up on the guest's screen.

Other checks:

- All unit tests pass.
- The decomp changes are inside `TARGET_PC` only; the matching build gives the same hashes.
- Android: the release-key signature (certificate `db6fc1ad…`) and the version (1.4.0, versionCode 10400).

Not tried in a test: turning a lamp on or off; two players picking up the same item at the same moment.

## Known limitations

- Each player has their own insects and fish, balloons floating by, Wisp's spirits, rolling snowballs, beach ball,
  money rock coins and bees. Visiting the host's island is not shared.
- The fishing bobber and line, and a letter or present being handed over, are not drawn on other players.
- A guest can turn a lamp in the host's house on or off only on their own screen; it follows the host's again when
  the host's changes.
- The houses' outside, the bridge and the like change on screen once that part of the town is entered again.
- Multiplayer between two real, different networks and on real Android devices has not been tried much.

Build instructions and detailed progress are in [docs/README.md](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/blob/main/docs/README.md).
